### Historical audit — S0249

**Source:** `S0249`, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_4/audit_sources/raw_failures/scene_rsi_v2_1/r2/fixed_h0/H0/test/commons_189918915/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file. Each observation is complete at the stated offsets.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Student request, line 1 [0,5606) | The explicit goal was to reconstruct a single 341 × 512 indoor photograph with separate meshes, matching geometry, materials, camera and framing. The image itself is not visible in this audit; a warehouse aisle is the student's inferred scene, not independently established fact. |
| Student response, line 3 [0,9948); execute step 1, line 4 [0,10580) | The student submitted and the runner attempted a nonempty program. It specified multiple objects: architecture, two racks, many cargo loads, skylight and fixtures. Colors and geometric seams, bands and creases approximated materials and texture; luminous Blender materials were assigned to named tubes and glazing. These are program specifications, not verified rendered appearances. |
| Student response, line 3 [0,9948) | Rack posts, rails, diagonal braces, pallet boards and loads were placed as separate parts, but physical connection, intersections and support were not checked. No articulated subject or pose is evident in the code. The camera was aimed upward and rolled −18°; area lights, Cycles, exposure and glow were configured. Whether these match the reference or cause framing, lighting or render problems is unknown. |
| Student session, line 2 [0,2846); execution result, line 5 [0,1065) | The initial session recorded zero tool calls. One build was attempted; Blender timed out after about 483 seconds, with empty stdout/stderr and no image. No rendered validation, correction, subsequent exploration or successful build is visible. The cause of the timeout—including whether scene complexity or rendering was responsible—is unresolved. |

**Teacher input:** No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, message to the student, or adoption is visible in this student trajectory. The record does not establish that a teacher intervened or that any advice was received.

**Outcome and lessons:** This is a **technical interruption with an unknown reconstruction outcome**, not an empty patch or demonstrated algorithmic failure. Neither geometric accuracy nor partial correctness can be independently assessed without the reference and a completed render; object names and code comments are not verification. A transferable operational lesson is that a first validation requires a build to finish within the available budget; a simpler initial build is a plausible hypothesis to test, not an observed remedy. The specific rack, lighting and camera choices remain task-specific hypotheses until visually checked.
